name: aitmpl
description: /aitmpl opens a flat side pane (plain text, no colours or icons) for the aitmpl.com catalog: a search box, the site's Browse menu with counts, an Installed section (agents, commands, skills and mods found in .claude/ and ~/.claude/), a Popular/Results list with download counts, and view/install on every row. Install runs the fixed CLI argv ($.process.run, validated path, no shell). The catalog is read live through $.http.fetch; browsing costs no tokens.

siteUrl.title: Site URL
siteUrl.description: The site whose public catalog JSON is browsed (counts.json, components/{type}.json)

pageSize.title: Rows per page
pageSize.description: Rows shown per section before "show more"

columns.title: Pane width
columns.description: Columns asked for the docked pane in the fullscreen layout (28-120); a width you drag it to wins
